prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1396; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my right ran the red and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt a sharp pain in my right shoulder almost immediately. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived and gave them my account, which I have kept consistent since that moment. Looking back, I have remembered a few more small details, such as the position of the other car's headlights and the sound of the brakes, but the core of what happened has not changed. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement so my claim can be reviewed.
